concerns.text: FR-003 mandates processing 'ChestX-ray14' images. The Plan explicitly removes this dataset (Spec Amendments #3, #5) and tasks T005/T019 explicitly exclude it. No task exists to implement the FR-003 requirement for ChestX-ray14, creating a direct contradiction where the spec requires a feature the plan and tasks have removed.

FR-004 requires comparing against 'bilinearly upsampled 64x64 ground truth'. The Plan amends this to 'native 1024x1024 ground truth' (Spec Amendments #1). Task T021 implements the native ground truth approach. No task exists to implement the original FR-004 requirement (upsampled ground truth), leaving the spec requirement unimplemented.

SC-005 mandates a 'one-sample t-test'. The Plan amends this to 'paired t-test/Wilcoxon' (Spec Amendments #4). Task T022 implements the paired/Wilcoxon approach. No task exists to implement the original SC-005 requirement (one-sample t-test), leaving the success criterion unimplemented.

Task T036 is a meta-task to 'Update spec.md' to reflect deviations. While this task exists, the current state of spec.md still contains the unamended FR-004 and SC-005. The coverage check flags that the *current* spec requirements (FR-004, SC-005, FR-003) have no corresponding implementation tasks because the tasks implement the *amended* plan instead. This is a spec/plan alignment issue.
